name: Mochie Water & Underwater Shader — Three.js WebGL2 Port
description: A faithful 1:1 WebGL2 / Three.js GLSL port of Mochie's Unity Water and Underwater Shaders featuring 4-wave Gerstner displacement, 3D Voronoi depth-projected caustics, screen-space refraction, subsurface scattering, edge/crest foam, and split-screen meniscus underwater post-processing.
